Complete remaining feedback/private-node and parameter cases, configuration coverage, whole-run memory/allocation, inner-solve cancellation and broader performance limits. Other state owners, VM transactions and full route coverage remain C01/C09/C12/C14 work. da18bfa88 adds independent bias-dependent forward/reverse charge oracles. 50523d8fb preserves small peripheral event-charge modes, with a six-node-order regression; the subsequent driven private high-injection convergence failure is repaired by the continuous-event integration references and event-approach fitting described below. Authenticated operating-point rate initialization and stationary-history event provenance repair the constant-bias private-node failure; static_private::gp_exact_phase_retains_a_small_reverse_charge_mode_at_private_dc_bias is active with unchanged accuracy limits. Audited integration-current references and balanced physical-event approach intervals repair the driven private-node regression, now active for all three dialects, both polarities and three bias regimes. The original 4 ps accuracy checks remain; BestAvailable additionally uses a 0.4 ps run to establish actual grid refinement against its already-adaptive 40 ps request, at the unchanged 0.7 error-reduction gate. Complete the remaining feedback/Weil, parameter, restart and resource/configuration qualification before C03c closes. C03d.1 now supplies physical voltage constraints, finite current, analytic time slopes and impulse ownership for structurally smooth prescribed behavioral forcing. The original sinusoidal behavioral-source reproducer has independent current/charge and checkpoint oracles in gp_phase_regimes/behavioral.rs. VCVS and VCCS now have physical event constraints/residuals, finite current and charge-impulse ownership; native VCCS current is observable through transient I(G...). Native CCCS now has weighted physical charge/current conservation, a constraint-consistent startup seed, and finite/impulsive F-current observations with independent startup, RC/refinement and restart tests. The direct current_controlled_startup_seed_satisfies_authored_voltage_constraints regression checks both source polarities, both VCVS gain signs and preservation of the incoming free coordinate; its reproduced sign reversal is repaired in the source/free-coordinate mappings, with checkpoint identity v105. Complete CCVS voltage-impulse descriptors, circuit-dependent/switched/stateful behavioral providers and remaining physical-event families/instances before C03d closes. d3d15ca70 delivers typed higher current impulse observations, analytic Fourier/rectangular-FFT contributions, result/live/compression/worker/Python persistence and accounting. core-current-derivatives-windows-20261006.json qualifies the bounded native, Python and optimized WASM routes. No physical provider produces the new derivatives yet. bcaefd8a3 implements analytic higher-current derivatives for every FFT window through the shared public retained-result route. core-window-derivatives-windows-20261006.json records independent 100-digit reference comparisons, boundary/range/resource/cancellation regressions, native integration and optimized WASM execution. Classical derivatives at genuine nonsmooth corners/support boundaries remain undefined and are diagnosed explicitly. ba2f8cfd4 implements direct current INTEG/AVG finite values and explicit primitive boundary availability, exact cross-owner support cancellation, live EQN/PARAM recovery and checked direct AT queries. core-measure-derivatives-windows-20261006.json records native and optimized WASM qualification. Generalized interval-operator composition, including nested INTEG/AVG and derived-expression distribution propagation, remains incomplete; support is propagated conservatively and unresolved interval consumers refuse rather than drop off-grid terms. Complete that algebra where defined, qualify genuine undefined-product/point-domain diagnostics, add voltage impulse observations and envelope projection, then circuit assembly/nonlinear coupling, atomic acceptance and public CCVS startup/event/restart evidence. Temporary refusals do not complete these implementations.

Deferred errors retain their selected declaration source. Ordinary static parameters finalize before model folding, eliminating a duplicate sample and ensuring model/parameter agreement. Function-bearing source cards are probed with an isolated random counter through the existing grammar; failed attempts and deferral classification do not consume live draws. AC DATA now rejects unconsumed trailing fields. core-analysis-card-transactions-windows-20261006.json records qualification. 42ed06c67 retains failed optional numeric expressions for validation instead of silently omitting them. d9af822b8 binds pending root analysis cards through the existing grammar after root parameter/source/model completion. Ready cards keep their eager values; pending cards capture available complex/scalar bindings, strings, functions and temperature builtins. Ordered completion preserves analyses, LIN/FFT auxiliaries, outputs, diagnostics and Monte Carlo source spans, with authored LIN/noise constraint validation. core-forward-analyses-windows-20261006.json records 26 numeric-family grammar checks and public DC/AC/transient, statistical, diagnostic, checkpoint and cancellation evidence. 0bb6ee975 generalizes the iterative numeric resolver to declaration ownership. 5550bb89a binds deferred subcircuit analysis operands against completed lexical ancestry, including unresolved header defaults and later parent/root declarations. Ngspice early provisional-temperature domain errors remain reproduced and need general dependency planning. General statistical/runtime binding, allocation and cancellation qualification remain open. c13b01791 preserves allocator causes across checked frequency-grid APIs and control/CLI/WASM/worker adapters; core-frequency-grid-errors-windows-20261006.json records scoped qualification. The full package remains in progress, including table control and general temperature dependency resolution. d63caea8a preserves physical source identity in typed AnalysisCardError values and ParseError::source_location(), including deferred root/scoped cards and continuation/include expansion, without replacing their typed issue. 520527555 retains the origin in the Python SDK projection and checks CLI message/line propagation. core-analysis-origins-windows-20261006.json records public native/sealed-source/WASM paths, constructor compatibility and idempotent attribution. fbf46d0fa reconciles failed deferred-analysis completion with discovered options and later scalar TEMP directives. Requirement-by-requirement committed-build audit across profiles/features; independent corpora, boundary fuzzing and failure atomicity. Investigate Windows compiler-build reproducibility: core-analysis-origins-windows-20261006.json preserves a Rust 1.95 expected-relocatable-expression failure while compiling rspice-core for a CLI test, followed by the same-command retry. This is separate from earlier Rust 1.94/faer compiler failures; passing runtime tests do not close these toolchain incidents. Investigate the native Windows wasm-bindgen-test-runner reliability incident in core-parent-temperature-windows-20261006.json: two multi-target runs crashed with 0xc0000005 before different test targets launched, at the same native executable fault offset. Affected targets and all selected core tests passed in partial/retry runs without source or runner changes; this does not qualify repeatable harness execution. core-provisional-parameter-temperature-windows-20261006.json records a further pinned Rust 1.94 rustc.exe access violation (0xc0000005) while rebuilding rspice-core at integration revision f8d45a153, before the parameter regression executable ran. The unchanged command passed after the other builds finished. The failure log is retained; no cause or toolchain reliability resolution is established.
